claims.claim: promptarena validate and promptarena export use packc/compiler
compiler.Check stages pack_id, pack_version, load, compile, skills, workflow, compositions, agents, governance, pack, pack_schema; early stages stop, later collect
compile prints warnings as '⚠ [stage] message' and fails with 'Compilation failed:'; exit 1 and no file on error
arena config, prompt configs and tool files are schema-validated on load; arena config requires providers and defaults
each prompt gets the default template/provider/validator pipeline
arena tools/workflow/agents/compositions/skills/pack_evals/pack_metadata map to pack tools/workflow/agents/compositions/skills/evals/metadata
a tool file that fails to load fails the compile
skill directory paths are made relative to the config's directory however -c is written; an @org/name reference stays a reference
packc compile sets name=id, version from --pack-version (default v1.0.0), description 'Pack containing N prompts', $schema latest URL, compilation block
default id from current directory name via SanitizePackID; non-letter start gets pack- prefix
pack_metadata wins over spec.metadata with a warning; otherwise first spec.metadata by prompt_configs id is promoted with a warning naming the others
missing media example files warn 'media(<task>): Media file not found: ...' relative to config dir (compile) or prompt dir (compile-prompt)

Each static fragment is read from its file and its content written to the pack's fragments under its name; a relative path resolves against the referencing prompt config's directory (the arena config's for an inline prompt_specs entry), then the working directory; a required fragment that cannot be read fails the compile stage with an error naming the file; an optional one is left out with a 'fragments:' warning; a reference with no path cannot be loaded; a {{ name or path is written as {{name}}
templates are not parsed; only check is that a template containing {{ declares at least one variable (pack stage error)
compile-prompt: id from task type (_ to -), name/description from prompt, version from spec.version or --pack-version, metadata from spec.metadata, $schema set
two compiles of the same inputs differ only in compilation.created_at
version: ldflags-stamped for releases, else module version from debug.ReadBuildInfo, else dev
compile-prompt checks the prompt config against its schema first, then runs the same structural and PromptPack schema checks; fails with no file written

template_engine is the one the prompts declare, chosen by the PromptKit compiler; differing engines fail the compile stage; prompts declaring none or the default are left out; no declaration gives v1 {{variable}}
invalid --id or --pack-version fails before loading anything; --pack-version must be a semantic version
promptarena run loads fragments the same way when it builds its prompt registry, so a missing required fragment stops the run before any scenario starts
compile-prompt resolves media references and fragment paths relative to the prompt file's directory
